about: One piece under 2026-09-20: the tagged Mara line with comment A under it, then the untagged post line with comment B under it. No typed request. u1 (tag-triggered) moves the Mara line to idea-mara and is approved; the findings list the post line as missed. The Edit guard gives [] and the run closes. The missed post line carries no status tag, so only a comment could have asked for it: its entry under Lines the checker says were missed gets one keep line for each comment in its piece, A then B, right above 'The next migration run tries this again.' No request was typed, so no request comment is written under the post line: the Brain Dump ends with only u1's pointer added. Both comments and the post line stay off the handled list.
